meta.title: Currencies, day-count names and central-bank meeting schedules (USD, EUR)
meta.description: Currencies point at their settlement calendar, discount index and default instrument. Day counts are CODE (include/epykos/conventions/daycount.hpp); the names listed here are documentation and are checked against the implemented set at load. Central-bank meeting dates are data for curve knot placement (G5).
sources: 2006 ISDA Definitions section 4.16 (day count fractions); 2021 ISDA Interest Rate Derivatives Definitions
Federal Reserve, FOMC Meeting calendars (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, read 2026-09-23)
ECB, Governing Council monetary policy meeting calendar (ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/mgcgc, read 2026-09-23)

imported_from.imported_from: SwapEngine/conventions/conventions.json (D37 data import), currencies.USD, currencies.EUR, day_counts, cb_schedules.USD, cb_schedules.EUR (as_of 2026-09-08)
notes: cb_schedules: USD 2026 Jan-Sep and 2027 Jan-Sep verified against federalreserve.gov on 2026-09-23; USD 2026-10-28, 2026-12-09, 2027-10-27, 2027-12-08 imported, UNVERIFIED by the fetch. EUR 2026-10-29, 2026-12-17 and all 2027 dates verified against ecb.europa.eu (decision day = second day of the two-day meeting); EUR 2026 Jan-Sep imported (past meetings), UNVERIFIED by the fetch.

sources.discount_index: SOFR discounting for cleared USD swaps since 2020-10-16 (CME / LCH discounting switch) - background, UNVERIFIED by fetch; PROBLEM.md Stage A: SOFR OIS is the USD discount curve

notes: SwapEngine settlement_calendar 'USD' (SIFMA) replaced by the joint SOFR swap calendar for swap dates; repo_day_count not imported (no bonds at Stage A)

sources.discount_index: €STR discounting for cleared EUR swaps since 2020-07-27 (CCP discounting switch) - background, UNVERIFIED by fetch; PROBLEM.md Stage A: €STR OIS is the EUR discount curve

30/360.description: 30/360 (Bond Basis, '30U/360'): D1 = 30 if D1 = 31; D2 = 30 if D2 = 31 and D1 is 30 or 31. The EUR IRS fixed-leg basis (CFTC MAT, Bloomberg SEF, Strata THIRTY_U_360).

30E/360.description: 30E/360 (Eurobond Basis): D1 = 30 if D1 = 31; D2 = 30 if D2 = 31. SwapEngine's EUR fixed-leg basis (recorded disagreement).

ACT/ACT ISDA.description: Actual/Actual (ISDA): days in a leap year / 366 plus days in a non-leap year / 365.

USD.source: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (decision day of each two-day meeting; 'Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it'); 2026-01-28 .. 2027-09-15 verified 2026-09-23, the Oct/Dec dates imported from SwapEngine as_of 2026-09-08 (UNVERIFIED)

EUR.source: ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/mgcgc (monetary policy meetings; decision day = second day); 2026-10-29 onward verified 2026-09-23, the 2026 Jan-Sep dates imported from SwapEngine as_of 2026-09-08 (past meetings, UNVERIFIED)
